note: Diffed validStableDelegate keys (reducer.ts:1749-1853) against EvenerDelegateInfo (types.gen.ts:590-660): latestIntent (649), logicalOwnerSessionId (604), reportPreview (627), reportPreviewTruncated (628) are absent from the keys array while hasOnlyKeys rejects unknown keys. cloneStableDelegate/mergeStableDelegate spread the whole object (reducer.ts:39-83), so these fields do reach cached state. title: Delegate projector join rule implemented twice with different timestamp semantics
note: reducer.ts:55-63 laterActivity uses Date.parse and millisecond compare; sessionActivityStore.ts:1300-1330 documents a strict RFC3339Nano parser and explicitly rejects Date.parse. Different semantics are real. Caveat: moving the strict rule to the reducer changes behavior for non-RFC3339 strings (they would now be ignored), so it is a behavior change needing the red test first.
revised_fix_plan: Red test first for sub-millisecond ordering, then move activityInstant/activityAfter/revisionOf/joinDelegateState into stableDelegate.ts, use from both, delete laterActivity. Check docs/product/session-activity.md.

title: Six-plus duration humanizers; a stale comment justifies the copies
note: Read watchRows.ts:41-80 and steeringNotifications.ts:840-870: identical ladders differing only in prefix. Stale comment at steeringNotifications.ts:831-834 says jobWatch.tsx owns the helper, but it is in watchRows.ts. Nuance: humanizeSeconds/Interval preserve fractional seconds (e.g. 1.5s) while the steering copies assume integer seconds (prose regex \d+), so a shared formatSpan must keep the fractional branch; outputs stay identical for integer inputs.
revised_fix_plan: Extract one formatSpan(totalSeconds) preserving the fractional sub-minute branch in displayFormat.ts; the four callers add their prefix. Keep existing test tables unchanged.

title: JSON-parse, field-reader and object-guard helpers re-implemented with subtly different semantics
note: isRecord is redefined in reducer.ts:1373 and memoryContext.ts:37 (identical bodies, non-strict, no prototype check) and plainObject.ts:10 is the stricter shared guard; that part is real and trivial. The broader claims (four parsers, str/strField/num/numField drift) I did not verify line by line; the benefit is mostly cosmetic and the strictness differences are deliberate per module. Downgraded.
revised_fix_plan: Only replace the local isRecord copies with isPlainObject (JSON-derived values, behavior-equivalent). Skip the new jsonFields.ts unless a concrete call site is shown to diverge.

title: keybindingsStore and transcriptDisplayStore are structural twins built as ~950-line closures with three in-memory draft ports
note: File sizes confirmed (1618 / 1353 lines). The two memoryDraftStorage versions differ deliberately and are documented: keybindingsStore.ts:81-102 returns unconditional true from removeIf/replaceIf and load null to avoid adopting a restoreDraft that reads null back; transcriptDisplayStore.ts:300-330 is a real single-slot CAS. Unifying changes keybindings draft retention semantics, which the comment says was chosen for a reason. Duplicate method bodies were not individually verified.
revised_fix_plan: Do not unify the two memory ports. If anything, move only the byte-identical draft helper bodies into checkpointedDraftEditor.ts after reading it, guarded by the existing store tests. Treat as low priority.
